test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The marked price of a mobile phone is Rs. 15,000 and the shopkeeper sold it for Rs. 13,500. What is the rate of discount offered by the shopkeeper?
solution:
Given:

Marked Price (M.P.) is Rs. 15,000

Selling Price (S.P.) is Rs. 13,500

Formula Used:

Discount % = discount/marked price × 100</p&g
